project_context: TradeOS Opportunity Workspace - Premium Dashboard for Contractors

font_families.mono_data: font-mono (JetBrains Mono) - MUST use for all numbers, currency, dates, and small UI labels

rules: Never center align body text. Maintain left alignment for readability.
Use font-mono for all tabular data, dates, and financial figures.
Heading hierarchy gaps must not exceed 2 tailwind steps.

backgrounds.app_base: #0a0a0a (Use bg-background, ensure it maps to this pure dark)

accents.primary: #10b981 (Emerald Green) - Use sparingly for 'Company Brain' accents, positive metrics, and primary CTAs.
accents.muted_emerald: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15) - Use for AI insight backgrounds

surfaces: Cards must use 'Neumorphism Dark' variant: bg-[#111111] with 1px border-[#262626] and NO heavy shadows. Flat and crisp.
Company Brain Insights must use 'Crystal Glass' variant: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#10b981]/5 border-[#10b981]/20.
visual_enhancers.corners: rounded-xl for main cards, rounded-lg for internal elements, rounded-full for badges.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Do NOT use full-surface gradients. Use subtle linear-gradients only for active state borders or AI insight highlights.

components_to_build.name: WorkspaceHeader
components_to_build.description: Sticky top command center. Includes Opportunity Name, Client, Workflow Badge (DISCOVERED, QUALIFYING, etc.), Mono-spaced Estimated Value, and primary CTAs.
components_to_build.instructions: Use flex-row with justify-between. Left side: Context (Labels + Title). Right side: Actions.

components_to_build.name: HorizontalNav
components_to_build.description: Persistent workspace navigation (Overview, Tender, Estimate, etc.).
components_to_build.instructions: Use flex gap-8 border-b border-[#262626]. Active state must have an underline (framer-motion layoutId recommended) and brighter text. Inactive text-white/50.

components_to_build.name: OverviewTab
components_to_build.description: Command Center grid. Must answer 'What needs my attention today?' within 5 seconds.
components_to_build.instructions: Implement 'MODE B: High Density Grid'. 3-4 columns. Top row: North Star metrics. Left col: Outstanding items. Right col: Company Brain & Timeline.

components_to_build.name: CompanyBrainInsight
components_to_build.instructions: Do NOT make it look like a chat box. Use an Emerald tinted glassmorphism card. Icon: Sparkles (Emerald). Tone: 'Quiet assistance'.

components_to_build.name: ActivityTimeline
components_to_build.instructions: Vertical line on the left (border-l). Small circular nodes for events. Time in font-mono.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 inside standard cards. Use gap-6 between grid items.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid_mode: MODE B (High Density Grid): grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Primary data spans 2 cols, feeds/timelines span 1 col but 2 rows (row-span-2).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over mathematical. Ensure numbers in columns align right.

motion_and_interaction.page_load: Staggered fade-in-up for grid items. Use existing classes: animate-fade-in-up animation-delay-100, etc.
motion_and_interaction.ai_reveal: Subtle pulse on the Company Brain icon to indicate a new insight.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over #111111 meets APCA standards. Use white/90 for primary text, white/70 for secondary.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (tabs, buttons, AI cards) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='tab-overview').

media.instructions: Use avatars for 'Assigned Team' overlaps. Use project thumbnails subtly if project imagery is needed in the header or background.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make this UI feel like a specialized, high-end operating system for contractors. It must not look like a generic Vercel template.
Enforce the 'Calm, premium and focused' mandate. Do not cram data. Use negative space (p-8) to separate sections.
Use framer-motion for tab transitions and card entrances if possible, or use the provided CSS animations.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; it must have a solid or frosted background to prevent text collision on scroll.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠. Use lucide-react icons (e.g., Sparkles, Lightbulb).
Company Brain is QUIET. It should look like an integrated part of the UI, perhaps a muted green card with a subtle border, not a glowing chat bubble.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid.
